summary.text: Ellen McLaughlin is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 36, which covers parts of Augusta and Rockbridge counties and the cities of Staunton and Waynesboro.
Ellen McLaughlin has been a member since 2023.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Ellen McLaughlin was born in Staunton, Virginia, in 1969.
Ellen McLaughlin studied at Averett University (B.A., Business Administration), the Virginia Bankers School of Bank Management, and the University of Virginia Darden School of Business.
Ellen McLaughlin's listed memberships and affiliations include New Beginnings Christian Church and Rockbridge Shenandoah AFCEA (treasurer).
The House profile lists Ellen McLaughlin's committee assignments as Rules, Counties, Cities and Towns, General Laws, and Appropriations.
